cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import random,time
from syntax import parse_policy
from ebpf.create_dfa import create,PolicyError
random.seed(506)
names=[chr(65+i) for i in range(16)];reg=[{'name':n,'label':i+1} for i,n in enumerate(names)]
base='(startswith(A,B) and contains(C,D)) allow;(endswith(D,A) or match(E)) allow;(contains(C,D) and startswith(A,B)) drop;(startswith(A,B) and (contains(C,D) or endswith(D,A))) allow;(endswith(D,A) and contains(C,D)) allow;'
for N in [7000,7050,7100,7150,7200]:
 S=set()
 while len(S)<N:S.add(tuple(random.randrange(16) for _ in range(7)))
 text=base+''.join('match('+','.join(names[i] for i in t)+') allow;' for t in S)
 p=parse_policy(text);t=time.time()
 try:im=create(text,reg,p);res=('ok',len(im['rows']))
 except Exception as e:res=(type(e).__name__,str(e))
 print(N,'time',round(time.time()-t,3),res)
PY
